test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 10 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

It was my niece / who was leaving college / last year, and / not my son.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect use of the past continuous tense "**was leaving**" in the context of a specific past event.
 
• To describe a completed action that happened at a specific time in the past, the past simple tense should be used.
 
• The correct phrase should be "**who left college**" to ensure grammatical correctness and clarity.
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 3** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It was my niece **who left college last year,** and not my son."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **4: "It was my niece"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **2: "last year, and"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **1: "not my son."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
